Round Insurance

Common perk · Scoring bonus

After losing a hand, your first scoring play next hand adds 5 points per stack.

In-game card text

How it works

After you lose a hand, your first scoring play of the next hand gains +5 points for each copy you held when the hand was lost.

  • The bonus is spent by your first play of the new hand whose open ends add up to a multiple of five, even if a malus reduces that play.
  • Winning a hand clears it. Losing two hands in a row does not build up two bonuses.

At a glance

RarityCommon
TypeScoring bonus
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
